summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 337,710 Class I common shares for $8,047,437 to feeder vehicles, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. It also declared monthly distributions across share classes and provided portfolio commentary, with NAV per share unchanged at $23.83. This is a routine private placement and ongoing disclosure, not a strategic special situation. No acquisition, tender, or restructuring activity is present. Watch for continued monthly distribution declarations and NAV stability as normal BDC operations.
